remarks: This move -in-ready 3-bedroom 1.1 bath Split Level home is conveniently located in a quiet West Seneca neighborhood close to schools, shopping, dining and everyday amenities, with the highway close by to get most anywhere in the area in 15 – 20 minutes.  Inside you will find a spacious and versatile layout featuring a spacious living and dining area with hardwood flooring along with a modern updated eat in kitchen, and a ½ bath.  Also, on floor 1 you will find the family room with sliding glass doors that lead out to the completely fenced back yard with no rear neighbors and trees as your backdrop.  The upstairs also features hardwood flooring in 3 good sized bedrooms and plenty of storage space.  The full bath located on the second floor is updated.  This home is freshly painted, has all new lighting in the last 6 years, a newer furnace  ‘20, a new sump pump '23, and an updated circuit breakers system.  There is a Google Thermostat for the heating/cooling system.  All appliances are negotiable and can stay with the home.  The refrigerator, washer, and dishwasher are all new.  Offers will be reviewed as they are received; the seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.
